name: The Orc Report
summary: Sifting through loose dirt in Dustwallow Marsh, you come upon an orc's severed hand clutching a tube carved from bone. Inside lies a dirt-stained parchment in Orcish script, which looks important. It is meant for a Theramore Lieutenant.

sections.title: A Hand in the Dirt
sections.body: In the loose dirt lies an orc's severed hand, gripping a tube carved from bone. Inside is a parchment stained with dirt and the writing is Orcish, which seems significant. A Theramore Lieutenant is the one to show it to.

sections.title: The Lieutenant's Verdict
sections.body: The lieutenant admits to reading Orcish poorly, yet takes the parchment for an orc spy's report.

faq.q: What is hidden in the loose dirt?
aliases: what do you find in loose dirt
faq.answer: Sifting through it turns up an orc's severed hand clutching a tube carved from bone, with a dirt-stained parchment inside.

aliases: where do I take the report

faq.q: What language is the parchment written in?
faq.answer: The writing is Orcish, and it seems significant.
